sources.entry: Swapjutsu - Character swap for videos with Seedance 2.5 or Wan 2.2 Animate, with on-device preparation on Apple silicon.

summary.one_liner: A free, open-source Mac app that swaps a character into an existing video, doing the preparation on-device on Apple silicon and rendering through Comfy's API or a self-hosted ComfyUI.
summary.what_it_does: Swapjutsu takes a short clip (trimmed to 4–30 s), finds shot cuts, and builds a separate mask for each person, tracking them across cuts with EdgeTAM in Core ML. It estimates depth per shot and builds a control video, all on the Mac. A local vision model can write the prompt and name the motion, and you assign a reference image to each character and optionally a background. The render step sends the control video and images to Seedance 2.5 or Wan 3.0 via Comfy's Partner Nodes API, Seedance via Comfy Cloud, or Wan 2.2 Animate on your own ComfyUI server. Drafts are rendered first, and you can finalize at 1080p within 7 days. The app also includes an MCP server so agents can prepare and render clips within a daily budget you set.
use_cases: swap a character into an existing video clip
replace a person in a video with another character
prepare video masks and depth on a Mac for AI rendering
draft AI character swaps at low cost before finalizing
run Wan 2.2 Animate on a self-hosted ComfyUI
let an AI agent render video swaps through MCP
how_to_run: Download Swapjutsu-.dmg from the latest release and drag the app to Applications
Verify the download with shasum -a 256 -c Swapjutsu-.dmg.sha256
Add a Comfy API key in Settings › Comfy
In Create, drop a clip, trim it, choose who to replace and click Prepare Clip
Drop character images and click Generate Draft
Build from source: scripts/fetch-models.sh then swift build --product Swapjutsu && .build/debug/Swapjutsu
notable: Runs prep (shot detection, per-person masks, tracking, depth, control video) fully on the Mac, offline, with the render step optional
Shows the price before a Generate Draft request is sent, with a cheaper 480p draft followed by a 1080p finalize
Ships an MCP server so Claude Code or other MCP clients can prepare and render, limited by a user-set daily budget
Models are pinned to commits or releases and checked against SHA-256 before use
Comfy key is stored in the macOS Keychain; no account and no telemetry
caveats: Requires macOS 15+ on Apple Silicon and Xcode 27 / Swift 6.4 to build from source
Rendering needs Comfy credits, a Comfy Cloud subscription, or a ComfyUI server with a capable GPU; prompt writer needs 16 GB memory
Seedance and Wan 3.0 renders are paid through Comfy; only Wan 2.2 Animate on your own ComfyUI is free
Unofficial, community-built project, not affiliated with Higgsfield, ByteDance or Comfy Org
